Practised finding number partners that make 10.
Answered 4 partner questions; 2 were unaided correct.

end.parentNote: Gauri practised making 10 in different ways using fingers and counting on. They correctly identified 7 and 3, and later explained that 3 folded fingers leave 7 standing fingers; they also found 8 and 2. There was an earlier mix-up between counting folded and straight fingers, which was corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise with small groups of objects: ask, “How many more make 10?” and have them show both parts.
